all_text_content:
Verse of the Day
Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for the Lord hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.
Isaiah 49:13
Quote of the Day
"Because of the Restoration, we understand the important and pivotal role Elijah has played in the salvation of mankind."
Elder Quentin L. Cook | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
